subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled Control UI JSON5 code-editor dependency for raw config editing, and should that path repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75466 or start from a fresh narrower PR?
rationale: The request fits web frontend ergonomics, but it adds a significant UI dependency and changes a sensitive config editing surface where maintainer product and compatibility intent should decide the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only if the implementation is rebuilt on current main, preserves reveal-to-edit and save/apply behavior, and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Keep the textarea for now
options.body: Decline the dependency/product surface until raw config editing becomes a higher priority or a lighter existing component is chosen.

options.title: Require a short design note
options.body: Keep the issue open but require a maintainer note comparing dependency choice, JSON5 formatting semantics, sensitive-value handling, and proof requirements before more code work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only if the implementation is rebuilt on current main, preserves reveal-to-edit and save/apply behavior, and includes real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the reveal-to-edit raw config flow that any editor replacement must preserve and is the strongest history-backed routing candidate.
